query:
DELETE FROM preferences
             WHERE (userid, category, name) IN (
                   SELECT userid, category, name
                     FROM preferences
                    WHERE category = $1
                      AND name = $2
                      AND (SUBSTRING(CONCAT('000000000000000', value), LENGTH(value) + 1, 15)
                               > '000000000000040'
                           OR SUBSTRING(CONCAT('000000000000000', value), LENGTH(value) + 1, 15)
                               < '000000000000001')
                    LIMIT 100
             )
